title: Tobacco & vanilla soy candle
subtitle: A warm, resinous jar candle with depth
excerpt: A soy wax jar candle scented with tobacco and vanilla fragrance oil, a warm, complex combination with a dry tobacco top note and a sweet vanilla base. Good for living rooms and evening settings. Makes one 200 ml jar candle; burns for around 35 hours.
sourceNotes: Tobacco and vanilla fragrance oil: a blended fragrance with strong hot throw in soy wax. Vanilla-dominant fragrances can discolour soy wax from white to yellow or brown over time, this is cosmetic. For UV stabilisation, add 0.5% UV inhibitor by wax weight; optional. Fragrance load 8% of wax weight is the recommended maximum for tobacco-vanilla blends in soy container candles. Confirm the specific fragrance oil's flash point before use; tobacco fragrances commonly have a flash point around 80°C, pour well below this.

recipe.batchNotes: Scale directly. Tobacco and vanilla fragrance oil at 8% produces a strong hot throw, verify the scent strength suits your space before scaling up.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Soy candles benefit from a 48-hour cure before burning. The scent throw is noticeably better after curing.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: Effective indefinitely in a cool, dark place. Vanilla-based fragrance oils cause wax to yellow over time, normal and does not affect the burn. Flash point safety: pour at 60°C; never at temperatures near the flash point of the fragrance.

glossaryTerms.definition: The temperature at which melted soy wax is poured into the jar. 60-65°C gives a smooth, even surface. Pouring hotter causes more shrinkage and sinkholes as the wax cools.
The first burn of a new candle, long enough to melt the wax all the way to the jar edge, setting the pool depth all future burns follow. Skip this and the candle tunnels.

content.text: Tobacco and vanilla soy candle is a dark, warm-scented jar candle suited to living rooms and evening use. The tobacco fragrance, a dry, slightly leathery top note, combines with a sweet vanilla base to give a complex scent that reads as warm rather than sweet. Soy wax holds fragrance oil well and gives a clean, even burn. One 200 ml jar; burns for around 35 hours.

items.prepNote: container-grade soy wax; melt point 48-53°C; pour at 55-60°C
8% of wax weight; add when wax is at 60°C
pre-tabbed cotton wick CD-12 or equivalent for 7 cm jar diameter

content.text: Fix the wick tab to the centre of the jar base. Use the wick-centring bar across the rim to hold the wick upright.
Melt the soy wax in the pouring pitcher over a simmering-water bath. Keep the heat low and watch the temperature, never leave melting wax unattended. Bring to 75°C.
Pour into the jar. Leave at room temperature for 24 hours. Trim the wick to 5 mm before lighting.
to reach the full jar diameter before extinguishing, about 3 hours for a 7 cm jar. Re-trim the wick to 5 mm before each subsequent burn.
Store in a cool, dark place. The wax may discolour slightly yellow from the vanilla component, this is normal and does not affect the burn quality or scent. The candle remains effective indefinitely.
